title: Lightningbane
body:
"A lightning infused pickaxe, repurposed to smash and destroy any electrified rock."

Description

The Lightningbane is an extremely speedy pickaxe with a decent area-of-effect. A full charge only takes about a quarter second, making this the fastest swinging pickaxe in the game. It is comparable to the Petalfall Katana in pickaxe form.

Appearance

The Lightning Bane Pickaxe looks like a staff with the Lightning Core affixed to the top, and the head being transparent and blue. Two glowing lightning bolt symbols protrude from the bottom of the handle. An electricity particle flows down both sides of the head and the handle from the core in the middle.

Obtaining

  1. Obtain the following materials:
    1. Zapium (Must be Forged)
    2. Reinforced Pickaxe
    3. Lightning Core
    4. Copper Axe (You will likely need more than one due to it having a 50% chance to lose it's lightning-summoning ability)
  2. Head to the area a ways behind Alan's AutoLogistics until you find the copper shrine with 4 lightning rods surrounding it.
  3. Wait for a thunderstorm to begin.
  4. Hold the Copper Axe inside of the outermost lightning rod until it is struck and activates.
    1. Do this for all 4 Lightning Rods.
  5. Carry the Zapium, Reinforced Pickaxe, and Lightning Core down the now-opened hole into the shrine, and place them into the blue bowl inside of the Cave.

For a simple and quick tutorial showing these steps, see this video.
